name: squiggle
title: Squiggle
description: A wavy, zigzag, looping or coiled line draws itself with a springy swim, settles, holds and erases.
useWhen: A title or number needs a lively hand-drawn style underline or flourish.
A playful accent line should draw in, wiggle and clear out.
avoidWhen: A clean, static divider is needed.
The line must connect two specific elements: it is placed at a fixed center and angle.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Weight
variables.description: Stroke thickness at a 720 px frame height.

variables.label: Angle
variables.description: Rotation of the line in degrees.

variables.label: X
variables.description: Line center across the frame, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Y
variables.description: Line center down the frame, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Settle
variables.description: How much the line calms down while it holds, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Hold
variables.description: Frames (30 fps) the finished line holds.

variables.label: Erase
variables.description: Erase the line at the end.

variables.label: Delay
variables.description: Frames (30 fps) before the line starts.
